actors.name: Donald Trump
actors.blurb: President Trump is dominating the news cycle with a flurry of actions: he pushed a controversial diesel deal with Russia, faced multiple federal judges ordering his administration to halt taxpayer‑funded TV ads and tree‑cutting on a D.C. golf course, and is actively campaigning across swing states ahead of the midterm elections, endorsing candidates and rallying his base.
signals: Judicial orders on ad spending and environmental actions
